enchantments.tooltip: Armor Bonus +6: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +6 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Fortification +77%: +77% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Exceptional Universal Spell Power +15: Passive: +15 Exceptional bonus to Universal Spell Power.
Efficient Metamagic - Maximize I: The additional spell point cost for using the Maximize Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP.

Disintegration Guard: This item has a store of dark, insidious power deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this power occasionally lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them.
